value.basis: 4B manufacturer2D drawing86.5×86.5×14.5 / TPVA72.53; ETH-2RO official dimension photograph86.5×86.5×36.5 / aperture71.93. Optical dimensions are deliberately not merged.

facts.method: Native CAD bounds and explicit manufacturer dimensional/photo reconstruction; no source scaling. Unknown placement, package differences and aperture/pixelaspect conflicts remain recorded.
facts.notes: No hardware-fit or browser/WebGL acceptance is implied by the retained CAD or CPU geometry checks. Factory display execution is independently recorded in product limitations; a model screen only shows the actual emulator framebuffer. Approximate exterior built from specific product dimensions/photos; internal board is UNKNOWN. Snapfits, speakerholes, screws, packaging refinements and physicalbutton identities at sidepositions require additional calibration. BOOT/relay runtime inputs remain available through exact product controls; no speculative 3D GPIO hotspot is assigned to unconfirmed sidebutton positions. USB visual mouths have open wall cutouts, but no connector pin order or cable mating is asserted.
facts.uncertainty: Only the cited manufacturer dimensions constrain the exterior. Component heights, internal board geometry, optical registration and connector placement are estimates where declared per part. No mechanical-fit acceptance.

GT911 触摸报告数字子集、I2C GPIO7/8、GPIO35 BOOT 已实现；多点、复杂配置与完整原厂界面未验证。
TF 默认64MiB FAT32与已有P4 SDMMC数字模型；独立原厂文件系统挂载、C6无线、CSI、USB、音频模拟、Ethernet及模拟电源未验收。
此配置使用虚拟 silicon rev3.01，仅用于匹配原始镜像范围；不是实物PCB修订声明，实际芯片应单独识别。
原始出厂镜像固定提交/实际SHA，分区和每个ESP段checksum/SHA已审计；simulationVerified=false，未做本次原厂启动或实机验收。
